title: Vulnerable Road User
event: Cyclist behavior near the intended path is unusual and difficult to predict.
context: Cyclist is weaving near the lane boundary. The autonomous system is yielding and has not committed to movement.

hold.feedback: Conservative safe state maintained around unpredictable vulnerable-road-user behavior.

context.feedback: Additional trajectory and scene context reviewed.

guidance.feedback: Guidance remained bounded, though continued yielding offered the stronger safety margin.

escalate.feedback: Escalation is acceptable if uncertainty cannot be resolved.
